Clippers @ Spurs 4/10 7:00 - Spurs should cruise, Clippers gutted
Knicks @ Wolves 8/10 7:00 - Champs visit Minnesota, Edwards out
Warriors @ Grizzlies 4/10 7:00 - No Curry, Draymond; thin Memphis

games.notes: Anthony Edwards is out and Kuminga is questionable for Minnesota. Still the best game on the board: the defending champion Knicks against a 11-4 Wolves team, should be close.
Beal and Ingram out for the Clippers; Harper and Harris out for San Antonio. Wemby and the Spurs should handle a depleted Clippers team, likely blowout.
Curry and Draymond out for Golden State; Edey and Jerome out, Stewart questionable for Memphis. Both on a back-to-back, so a sloppy, short-handed game.
Kuzma and Turner out for Milwaukee; Avdija and Camara questionable for Portland. Young Blazers against a 1-14 team on a back-to-back, likely blowout.
